contract.task_clause:
A researcher finds that age is negatively correlated with cigarette smoking; this means that
Option A: Older adults experience more negative effects from smoking that do younger adults
Option B: Older adults smoke more than younger adults
Option C: Older adults smoke less than younger adults
Option D: Older and younger adults smoke about the same number of cigarettes and both experience negative effects
